description: This file is a header for memory management functions in the USP (User Services Platform) agent, including memory allocation, deallocation, reallocation, duplication, and related macros and functions. It defines the interface for custom memory handling specific to USP agent implementation.

methods.name: USP_MEM_Init
methods.description: Initializes the USP memory management system.

methods.name: USP_MEM_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys the USP memory management system, freeing resources if necessary.

methods.name: USP_MEM_Malloc
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of given size, with debugging information.

methods.name: USP_MEM_Free
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated memory block with debugging info.

methods.name: USP_MEM_Realloc
methods.description: Resizes a previously allocated memory block.

methods.name: USP_MEM_Strdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string with debugging info.

methods.name: USP_MEM_StartCollection
methods.description: Begins a memory collection session for debugging or leak detection.

methods.name: USP_MEM_PrintSummary
methods.description: Prints a summary of memory usage.

methods.name: USP_MEM_PrintLeakReport
methods.description: Outputs a report on memory leaks.

methods.name: MAIN_Stop
methods.description: Function to stop the main process or system, possibly related to memory cleanup.
